botAvatar.reference: Предыдущая версия bot-avatar.jpg: красный осколок с золотыми трещинами на фоне ярмарки.
botAvatar.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Telegram bot profile avatar for the dark-fantasy game 'Ярмарка украденной магии'. Input image: current avatar, reference for its red crystal and warm gold color identity. Completely simplify this avatar into ONE unmistakable RPG emblem that reads instantly in a 40-pixel circle. Keep only ONE large ruby-red crystal shard, a bold wide angular diamond silhouette with only THREE or FOUR broad painted facets and ONE thick glowing molten-gold lightning-shaped fissure through its center. Strong crimson red, orange-gold, and near-black burgundy palette. Classic hand-painted RPG icon with clean chunky edges and minimal surface texture. The crystal is centered and occupies the central 68 percent of the square so its complete silhouette survives Telegram circular cropping. Plain very dark burgundy-black background with one subtle warm halo. No stalls, no market, no lanterns, no moon, no buildings, no decorative border, no tiny shards, no tiny sparks, no text, no letters, no characters, no additional objects. It must look like a simple iconic magical object, NOT a detailed scene or an ornate illustration. Preserve the red crystal with gold fissure as the recognizable identity.
